summary_en: 2,000,000 ordinary shares (5.16% of S/O) to be cancelled effective 2026-06-30. Post-cancellation issued share count: 36,742,241 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Kanamoto Co., Ltd. announced on 2026-06-05 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 2,000,000 ordinary shares held in treasury, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 5.16% of issued shares outstanding. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-06-30. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued share count will be 36,742,241 shares.
